styleBlock: STYLE (locked, war-room v3 anchor): warm night-office mood — amber desk-lamp key light from screen-left, deep teal-navy shadow tones, muted terracotta / teal / moss accent palette; pixel-art-adjacent painterly digital illustration with crisp clean edges and flat chunky color planes; cozy late-night studio feel; NO photorealism, NO watermarks, NO signature.
portraitBlock: FRAMING: dossier bust portrait — head and shoulders only, subject turned slightly left of camera, calm neutral relaxed expression (no smile, no frown, no raised eyebrows), plain dark warm-brown background with a soft amber rim light on screen-left. PERSONALITY-NEUTRAL: no props, no badges, no logos, no jewelry statements, no expression cues — a plain staff-file photo.

assets.name: poster_stop_all
assets.purpose: STOP ALL safety poster — wall prop art; octagon SHAPE + text carry the signal (colorblind-safe, survives grayscale)
assets.prompt: A vintage industrial workplace-safety wall poster on aged warm cream paper. Dominant centered element: a large red stop-sign OCTAGON with bold white capital letters reading STOP ALL inside it. Below the octagon, bold dark capital letters read: HALT EVERY RUNNING AGENT. Small footer caption in capitals: PULL BEFORE YOU PANIC. High contrast, extremely legible typography, flat print style, slight paper grain, thin dark border.

assets.name: poster_ship_it
assets.purpose: SHIP IT motivational poster — wall prop art for the office walls
assets.prompt: A vintage WPA-style motivational workroom poster. Giant bold condensed capital letters reading SHIP IT in warm cream, stacked on a deep teal-navy field, with stylized amber sunburst rays radiating behind the letters. A narrow footer band reads in small capitals: DONE IS A FEATURE. Crisp, extremely legible typography, flat screen-print texture, thin border.

assets.name: placard_wing_a
assets.purpose: WING A wayfinding placard — wall prop art; letter + arrow shape carry the signal
assets.prompt: An interior wayfinding sign: a wide rectangular brushed-brass plate mounted on a warm dark walnut wood backing board. Engraved large capital letters read WING A on the left side, and a clean engraved arrow points to the RIGHT on the right side. Minimal, premium, extremely legible, straight-on view, soft warm overhead lighting.

assets.name: placard_wing_b
assets.purpose: WING B wayfinding placard — wall prop art; letter + arrow shape carry the signal
assets.prompt: An interior wayfinding sign: a wide rectangular brushed-brass plate mounted on a warm dark walnut wood backing board. Engraved large capital letters read WING B on the left side, and a clean engraved arrow points to the LEFT on the right side. Minimal, premium, extremely legible, straight-on view, soft warm overhead lighting.

assets.name: poster_help_chart
assets.purpose: HELP vocabulary wall chart — wall prop art listing the 8 board verbs with plain-language glosses
assets.prompt: An office reference wall chart, flat print style on warm cream paper. Across the top, a solid amber header band with bold dark capital letters reading HELP. Below, a single-column vocabulary list of exactly eight rows, each row a bold capital keyword followed by a short lowercase gloss, extremely legible with generous line spacing: DISPATCH send an agent. APPROVE clear a gate. ACK mark a crisis seen. SWEEP clear stale alerts. REWORK retry a failure. DISMISS drop a crate. CALL open a live line. STOP ALL halt everything. Thin dark rule lines between rows, thin border around the chart.

assets.name: board_logo
assets.purpose: Studio logo lobby board — wall prop art; the WAR ROOM wordmark
assets.prompt: A studio lobby logo board: a rectangular dark walnut wood board with the wordmark WAR ROOM in large inlaid brass capital letters, and a smaller brass sub-line underneath reading OPERATIONS STUDIO. A subtle warm spotlight glow from above, straight-on view, minimal, premium, extremely legible.

assets.name: tex_wood_floor
assets.purpose: Seamless-ish wood plank floor texture — canvas floor fill
assets.prompt: A seamless tileable top-down texture of warm oak wood plank flooring: staggered planks, subtle grain variation between planks, matte finish. Perfectly even diffuse lighting, no shadows, no vignette, no perspective — flat orthographic top-down, edges designed to tile.
